# Trimlly

> Free Salon Management System & Barber Appointment Booking Platform in India.

Trimlly (https://trimlly.solvantis.in) is an Indian salon management software and consumer appointment booking platform connecting customers with verified barbers, unisex salons, and beauty parlours across major Indian cities including Indore, Bhopal, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad.

## Core Capabilities

- **Free Salon Management Software for Barbers & Salon Owners**: Modern digital appointment book, real-time chair availability calendar, staff scheduling, customer queue management, and client records with zero monthly subscription fees and 0% booking commission.
- **Consumer Barber & Salon Booking**: Real-time slot reservation, transparent INR menus, verified customer reviews, and instant confirmations without waiting in physical salon queues.
- **Automated Communication**: Instant SMS and WhatsApp appointment reminders to eliminate salon no-shows.
- **Direct UPI & Cash Payments**: Salon owners collect payments directly via UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) or cash. Trimlly never deducts middleman commissions.
- **Verified Local Salons**: Curated directory of independently vetted neighborhood barbershops, unisex salons, and luxury grooming studios.

## Primary Pages & URLs

- [Free Salon Management Software](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/for-barbers): Complete overview for Indian salon owners and independent barbers looking for modern salon management software.
- [Find Salons & Barbers](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/barbers): Search verified salons and view real-time availability across Indian cities.
- [Haircut & Styling Services](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/services/haircut): Browse top haircut and hair styling specialists with transparent INR prices.
- [Beard Grooming Services](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/services/beard-trim): Book professional beard trimming, shaping, and hot towel treatments.
- [Hair Colour & Highlights](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/services/hair-colour): Compare and book hair colouring, highlights, and hair spas.
- [Grooming Journal & Guides](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/blog): In-depth articles covering salon management software comparisons, haircut prices in India, and grooming trends.
- [Customer Reviews](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/reviews): 100% verified customer reviews submitted after completed salon visits.
- [About Trimlly](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/about): Mission, technology, and vision for digitizing India's personal care ecosystem.
- [Contact Support](https://trimlly.solvantis.in/contact): Support for salon partners and customer booking inquiries.
